prompt: Fix formatPages so every input page is preserved, joined by a newline. Empty input returns an empty string. Preserve the input array.
Implement chunks(values, size): contiguous ordered groups of at most size. Require a positive safe integer size; invalid sizes throw RangeError. Empty values returns [], and input is preserved.

Unify retailTotal and wholesaleTotal behind exported priceTotal(rows, discountPercent). Keep existing exports and behavior, validate percent from 0 through 100 inclusive and finite. Do not mutate rows. Each row has nonnegative integer priceCents and quantity.

Fix resolveAsset(root, decodedRelativePath) to return only paths strictly beneath root. Reject absolute paths, root itself and traversal outside root with Error. Paths are already decoded; support this host path conventions and sibling-prefix attacks.

Implement renderThemeControl(enabled, label) as an accessible native button HTML string. Include type=button and aria-pressed=true/false; escape user label text so it cannot create elements or attributes. No framework needed.

Implement async runWithRetry(operation, maxAttempts). Invoke until success or attempt limit, retry only errors with retryable===true, preserve the final error identity. Positive safe integer attempts required; invalid values throw RangeError before calling operation.

Fix summarize(values): ignore null/undefined as missing, retain numeric zero and negative values, reject non-finite or nonnumeric present values with TypeError. Return {count, sum, mean}, with mean:null for no observations. Preserve input.

Implement applyProfilePatch(profile, patch): only own properties of patch may change name or bio. Missing fields preserve values; bio:null clears bio; name must be a nonempty string and bio either null or string. Return a fresh object and preserve inputs.

Prepare the invoice app configuration for production. releaseConfig(env) must reject a missing/blank DATABASE_PATH or SECRET_KEY and require PORT to be decimal digits for an integer from 1 through 65535. Keep valid server settings unchanged. Only appName, from PUBLIC_APP_NAME or the default Invoices, may appear in publicConfig; server environment values must not reach browser delivery. Preserve caller input. Show what you checked and what remains unverified.
